exact.这一天不卖。货加二。客人不算走。: No sale today. Stock plus two. The customer does not count as a walkaway.
exact.客人记得昨天。加价一次只能加一，而且不能超过袋子。: Customers remember yesterday. A raise is only one, and it cannot pass the purse.
exact.走掉的人不改昨天的价钱。一次走掉比两笔薄利更贵。: A walkaway does not change yesterday. One walkaway costs more than two thin sales.
exact.把客人袋子比昨天高还是低、你是加价还是降价写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当: Write whether the purse was above or below yesterday, and whether you raised or cut, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
